text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:
- Berner Holding announced its plan to cut 70 of 1,900 jobs at Berne Insurance Group in Switzerland before the end of the year.

- Winterthur Insurance Group's consolidated gross premiums grew by 16 percent to 26 billion Swiss francs in 1996. Profits rose by 21 percent to over 500 million francs, and the dividend will be raised by two francs to 21 francs per share.

- The European Commission will investigate the merger of chemical group Clariant and Hoechst Special Chemicals, according to competition officials in Brussels. The Group is expected to achieve sales of 8.9 billion Swiss francs this year.
- The number of bankruptcies filed in Switzerland in the first four months of 1997 fell by 2.4 percent to 3,193.

- Assembly equipment maker Esec Holding's 1996/97 fiscal yea profit fell to 11 million Swiss francs from 26 million the previous year. It also announced plans to cut its dividend to 4.20 Swiss francs from 11 francs per share.
